titulo: Manual reduction and splint fixation for distal radius fracture with dislocation: a case report

fig.label: Figure 1
fig.caption: Anteroposterior and lateral wrist DRs from the emergency department and after reduction. (a,b) emergency DRs showing distal radius and ulna fractures, with radial dorsal displacement of the radius and a distal ulnar styloid fracture. (c,d) post-reduction DRs demonstrating satisfactory reduction of the radius, with evidence of DRUJ separation. DR, digital radiograph; DRUJ, distal radioulnar joint.
